info_entries.title: Compact FreeCAD Engraving Guidelines
description: To engrave text on a shape (e.g., base_shape) in FreeCAD with minimum lines of code:

1. Create the ShapeString text object. IMPORTANT: Draft.makeShapeString() always creates its object in FreeCAD's global App.ActiveDocument, not necessarily your local 'doc' variable. If ActiveDocument differs from 'doc' (e.g. a stale/other document is active in the process), the txt object ends up in a different Document than 'doc', and assigning it to ext.Base later raises 'PropertyLink does not support external object'. ALWAYS pin the active document immediately before creating the ShapeString:
2. Position the text relative to its boundbox (e.g. centered or offset):
offset_z = plate_thickness # On the top surface
3. Create and configure Extrusion downward, then Cut from the base shape:
ext.Base, ext.Dir, ext.LengthFwd, ext.Solid = txt, (0, 0, -1), engraving_depth, True
info_entries.rule: Use this compact sequence to generate engraving features in FreeCAD.
